modules.module_title: Assist in identifying the works to be taken up

pcs.pc_description: conduct village-level survey through coordination with the TA/ JE/AE to identify the potential work sites such as water bodies, streets, ridges, contours, and work suitable for taking up under the MGNREGA
select the worksites and work to be taken up based on survey and study of topographic sheets and maps
assist the TA/ JE/ AE in mapping the required resources for works to be taken up under MGNREGA in the identified areas

assist the TA/ JE/ AE in preparing the workbook regarding the work estimates
prepare index map and sketches for each type of work, along with the work input data sheet meant for the preparation of work estimates

modules.module_title: Assist in preparing for work at the worksite

pcs.pc_description: assist the GP in the procurement of quality construction materials such as cement, stones, bricks, etc.
arrange for safe and efficient storage of construction materials at the worksite, ensuring the quality of materials and prevention of wastage

modules.module_title: Assisting in supervising the execution and quality of work

pcs.pc_description: assist the mates and Rozgar Sevak in providing worksite facilities
conduct regular worksite visits to check work execution and ensure the work is carried out as planned, and according to the mark-out, work specifications and applicable quality standards
ensure work is completed as per the applicable standards and within the agreed Turn- Around-Time (TAT)
ensure tools, implements and equipment are used safely and are maintained as per the manufacturer’s instructions
ensure the remaining material is kept protected at the work site for future use or returned to Gram Panchayat/ seller, following the applicable procedure
coordinate with the TA/ JE/ AE for reviewing and verifying the measurements of work done by each group as recorded in the M Book
assist the TA/ JE/ AE in checking the quality of work carried out by each group to get approval
assist in taking appropriate corrective action as per the applicable standards, if any defects are identified in work

modules.module_title: Assist in ensuring adherence to health and safety standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure the labourers follow the applicable occupational health and safety measures, such as the use of the relevant Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), barriers, and warning signs at the worksite
check the availability of fully-equipped first aid kit with each labour group on the site and ensure the mate of the group is trained in providing first aid
optimise the usage of water and other resources in various tasks and processes, ensuring the labourers do the same
arrange for any water leakages to be plugged to prevent its wastage

modules.module_title: Perform and ensure effective waste management

pcs.pc_description: segregate waste into appropriate categories, also guiding the labourers on the process
recycle the recyclable waste appropriately and dispose the non-recyclable waste in an environment-friendly manner, urging the labourers to follow the same practices
